title: Loot
html:
Loot is another word for Valuable Items, it is used in much MMO's. Loot in Dungeon Runners has different ranks, below a list, in order of value.

Grey (White) - Is the most common Loot, most people don't even pick them up because of their low value.

Green - Is common Loot, much people don't pick them up either because they are of little value.

Blue - Is the regular Rank, also the best type of Loot avaible for non-members.

Yellow - Member only Loot (75% dropped by mobs available to Non-Members as of build 99). They are not very rare, and have an average value.

Purple - Member only Loot (25% dropped by mobs available to Non-Members as of build 99). They are quite rare, and much Members wear Purple items.

Rainbow - Member only Loot (25% dropped by mobs available to Non-Members as of build 99). They are extremely rare and are very wanted. Their value is very high and much people like to give them away to someone that is member or can use it instead of selling it to a Merchant.
